Other Repositories (Pinned)

  • openclaw 388.9k 81.7k
    The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
  • deckhand 4 0
    Anki add-on exposing a local MCP server so AI assistants like Claude and Codex can inspect and operate your collection
  • ankicli 6 3
    Automation-grade Anki CLI for safe, local-first collection management, study flows, and agent use.
  • officewizards-agent-skills 1 1
    Office Wizards agent skills and plugin manifests.

Hi, I'm Tak

I build agent-first software, learning tools, and developer tooling.

I am currently focused on software that humans install and supervise, but agents can operate directly through strong CLI surfaces, structured output, and safe automation workflows.

Current Projects

  • ankicli - agent-first Anki CLI for studying, card authoring, deck management, media workflows, and automation.
  • winmote - remote control and automation tooling for Windows workflows.
  • agent-scripts - reusable automation and maintainer scripts for agent-driven workflows.

What I Like Building

  • agent-operated software
  • learning systems
  • CLI-first products
  • automation-heavy developer tools
  • local-first workflows with clear safety boundaries

Current Direction

Right now I am especially interested in a new era of software where:

  • humans choose the tools, install them, and set the constraints
  • agents operate the software directly
  • the product surface is designed for both supervision and execution

That shows up in my work as structured CLIs, installable skills, automation primitives, and products that are easy to hand off to an agent harness without losing control.

Selected Repositories

  • ankicli - learn anything through Anki with an agent-first command line.
  • winmote - Windows remote-control and automation tooling.
  • pide - editor and developer-tooling experiments.

Working Style

  • build real tools
  • keep the interface sharp
  • optimize for fast iteration
  • make the system legible enough for humans and agents
